note: Short meanings for words a returning player meets. Each one quotes a cached UESP page; build.py checks every quote and number.

terms.t: Points you earn with experience after level 50. They let you wear stronger gear and use stronger consumables up to CP 160.
q: Gaining Champion Points allows players to equip more powerful gear and use more powerful consumables, up to the Champion Progression Cap of 160.
The Champion System is unlocked when one of your characters reaches Veteran rank at Level 50.

terms.t: The harder version of content, open once you reach the maximum level.
terms.q: Upon reaching the maximum level, players unlock Veteran content and receive 10 points into the Champion system.

terms.t: Swapping up to two of your class skill lines for lines from other classes.
terms.q: It allows a player to customize their character by replacing up to two of their class' skill lines with those from other classes.

terms.t: Passive skill lines for each class, added in Update 50.
terms.q: Class Mastery is a skill system introduced with Update 50 that provides passive skill lines for each of the seven Player Classes.

terms.t: An active skill that reached rank 4 can be morphed into one of two new versions.
terms.q: They have 4 Ranks, after which they may be Morphed into a new version.

terms.t: A third resource, used by Ultimate skills instead of Magicka or Stamina.
terms.q: Ultimate Skills are similar to Active Skills, but instead of using Stamina or Magicka as most Active Skills do, these use a third resource called Ultimate.

terms.t: A special ability your allies can activate when you use certain skills or sets.
terms.q: Synergies are special abilities that other allied players may activate when you use certain skills or sets.

terms.t: The state an enemy enters when you block its heavy attack; a heavy attack on it then knocks it down for 70% more damage.
q: Blocking an enemy's heavy attack will set it Off Balance.
Using a heavy attack against an Off Balance opponent will knock them down, deal 70% more damage and restore double the resources.

terms.t: How much of your damage breaks through an enemy's armor.
terms.q: Penetration is a value that represents how much of your damage will break through an opponent's armor.

terms.t: A standing stone that gives one permanent blessing at a time.
terms.q: Mundus Stones are standing stones dedicated to the Constellations.

terms.t: A two-piece set (head and shoulders) named after a dungeon boss.
terms.q: Monster Helm Sets (commonly called "monster heads") are a subset of dungeon sets of armor.

terms.t: A one-piece set you build from Antiquities leads.
terms.q: Mythic Items are special one-piece sets that can only be obtained through the Antiquities system and if you have access to the related DLC.

terms.t: The stronger version of a trial or arena set, dropped only on Veteran.
terms.q: Perfected versions of trial and arena sets only drop in Veteran mode.

terms.t: An optional harder fight on the last boss of a Veteran dungeon.
terms.q: For an even greater challenge, Veteran Dungeons have an optional Death Challenge (more commonly called "Hard Mode") that can be activated on the last boss.

terms.t: A daily Undaunted quest to clear a group dungeon, open from level 45.
terms.q: Undaunted Pledges are Daily Quests which become available at Level 45 from the Undaunted Enclave in your Alliance Capital

terms.t: The currency you spend to change an item's trait to one you have researched.
terms.q: 50 Transmute Crystals are used to change the traits of armor and weapons to a trait previously researched for that item.

terms.t: A collectible found around the world; collecting them gives skill points.
terms.q: Skyshards are collectible items that can be found throughout the world.

terms.t: An activity and rewards system added in Update 44.
terms.q: Golden Pursuits is an activity and rewards system introduced with Update 44.

terms.t: A battle pass-style reward system.
terms.q: Tamriel Tomes is a battle pass-style reward system for Elder Scrolls Online.

terms.t: Scaling that raises a lower-level player's attributes, armor and damage so they stay competitive.
terms.q: this also stacks with "battle leveling", which scales up their attributes, armor, and damage ratings in order to remain competitive.

terms.t: Debuffs you pick at the start of a solo dungeon; they set its difficulty and rewards.
terms.q: Meted Misfortunes are a mechanic unique to the Solo Dungeons, which control the difficulty level and rewards the dungeon will have.

terms.t: In the Infinite Archive you start with three Threads (lives); Verses are temporary buffs that last until the end of the next Stage.
q: When you first enter the Archive, you will have three Threads available
Verses are temporary buffs that last until the end of the next Stage.

terms.t: Synergies that appear at the start of each round in most arenas.
terms.q: A core mechanic of most Arenas is the presence of Sigils, synergies that appear at the beginning of each round of combat.

terms.t: While Enlightened you earn experience four times faster toward Champion Points; you get 400,000 XP of it per day.
q: While you are Enlightened, experience gain is multiplied by four
Once per day, you receive 400,000 XP of Enlightenment

terms.t: An armor trait that makes your Mundus Stone stronger.
terms.q: Armor with the Divines Trait increases the effect of Mundus Stones, depending on the Armor's quality.

terms.t: What crafting professions use to level up.
terms.q: All seven crafting professions use Inspiration for leveling purposes.

terms.t: Ingredients used to improve a crafted piece further.
terms.q: the piece can be augmented even more through the use of tempers.
